The Conflux Water Charge Air Cooler (WCAC) is engineered for high-performance systems that demand consistent power, seamless integration, and proven durability. Designed with advanced additive manufacturing and validated through computational fluid dynamics, it transforms charge-air cooling into a measurable performance advantage, balancing power, reliability, and cost-cap compliance.

In competitive racing, cooling defines competitiveness. Conflux WCACs can be tuned for extreme powertrain demands where stable charge-air temperatures sustain lap-after-lap performance. Combining lightweight construction with precision configurability to manage pressure drop and heat rejection, teams gain the balance of speed, reliability, and compliance to cost-cap regulations.

The Conflux Core™ is our proprietary internal geometry developed through additive manufacturing. It combines ultra-fine structures and tunable flow paths to deliver high-efficiency heat transfer, controlled pressure drop, and system-specific adaptability. The Conflux Core™ is the foundation that makes compact, lightweight, and production-ready cooling possible.

The Conflux high performance oil cooler is engineered for high-performance automotive and motorsport powertrains that demand stable lubricant temperatures, seamless integration, and long-term reliability. Developed using advanced additive manufacturing and validated through CFD and lab testing, balancing component protection, efficiency, and packaging constraints.

Internal geometries are fully configurable, enabling tailored fluid paths that balance heat transfer, pressure drop, and packaging to each powertrain’s performance targets and boundary conditions. This design flexibility accelerates development, reduces overall program cost, and delivers oil‑cooling systems that perform reliably in demanding racing and high‑performance road environments.
Conflux Core™ geometries can be tuned to suit oil properties, maximising heat transfer while meeting strict oil‑side pressure drop targets.
Ports, ducts, mounts and sealing features can be printed monolithically into the cooler, reducing plumbing, leak paths
